text.en: The coconut farm harvested 1,117 coconuts in April. How many customers can be served, and how many bags are needed?

Read, estimate, solve, and check.
Each bag holds 25 coconuts. To pack 75 coconuts you need 3 bags. If coconuts are left over, one more bag is needed for them.
582 coconuts sold equally to 6 customers is 582 / 6 = 97 each. Estimate: 600 / 6 = 100.
Susie and Sunitha solve division in two ways. Sunitha chooses the quotient more carefully to take away larger chunks, which makes the method shorter.
Sabina cycled 160 km in 20 days at the same distance daily: 160 / 20 = 8 km a day.
To buy coconuts worth Rs 4,200 with Rs 100 notes she needs 4,200 / 100 = 42 notes.
Think about the remainder. In sharing people it may mean extra things; in packing it may mean one more bag.
